newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philadelphia Suburban raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philadelphia Suburban raised.

text.p: -- Edward Jones on Wednesday raised its rating for Philadelphia Suburban Corp to strong buy from buy based on an attractive valuation of the company's stock.
-- A recent stock price decline opens an opportunity for investors seeking a growth and income investment in a relatively low-risk industry, Edward Jones said.
-- Philadelphia Suburban's balance sheet is now strong and cost controls have improved earnings, Edward Jones said.
-- The company's principal operating unit, Philadelphia Suburban Water Company, provides water to about 265,000 customers in 82 municipalities in southeastern Pennsylvania.
-- Its shares were up 3/8 Wednesday at 17.
